voxy.config.general.serviceThreads.toolt: Number of threads the ServiceThreadPool can use
voxy.config.general.useSodiumBuilder.too: Uses sodium builder threads as part of voxys thread pool, can reduce stuttering and lag when moving quickly at high render distance
voxy.config.general.ingest.tooltip: Enables or disables voxies ability to convert new chunks into LoDs
voxy.config.general.showJoinMessage.tool: Show version and credit information whenever joining a server or world; disable it here
voxy.config.general.earthCurveRatio.tool: 0 disables curvature; larger values produce a stronger curve beyond the vanilla chunk boundary.
voxy.config.general.subDivisionSize.tool:
Adjusts terrain and dedicated model detail. Move right for higher precision; level 4, Standard, is the default.
Lower levels select coarse meshes earlier for Domum, opaque Copycat/LittleTiles, trains, bogeys, tracks, contraptions and kinetic parts, and reduce wire segments. Higher levels retain detail at greater GPU cost. Dedicated coarse meshes share terrain section boundaries and subdivision rules. Nearby/handoff meshes stay complete; zooming in or increasing resolution restores detail.
Coarse transitions can change silhouette, texture or lighting detail. Prebaking levels adds bake time and CPU/GPU memory use. Dedicated translucent meshes only use safe coplanar merging; beams and lasers retain minimal shapes. Sable retains native full geometry, with quality affecting only tiny-object culling.
Subdivision values: 1024, 768, 512, 256, 123, 64, 28. Existing values map to the nearest level.
voxy.config.general.renderDistance.toolt: Render distance of voxy in chunks
voxy.config.general.renderPressure.toolt: Controls Voxy's per-frame LOD build pressure, including top-level node processing rate and render-thread model baking budget. Lower values prioritize FPS and reduce stutter while moving; higher values make LODs catch up faster. This option is hot-reloadable.
voxy.config.general.lodBoundaryFade.tool:
Gradually blends normal and distant terrain to soften the transition. Water uses a separate transition.
Risk: the blend may show grain or flicker. Disable when your shader pack already provides distant-terrain fading (such as Photon), to avoid duplicate fading or shadow boundaries. This improves appearance, not necessarily FPS.
voxy.config.general.lodBoundaryFadeLengt:
Sets the blend width in blocks. Requires smooth terrain blending.
Tradeoff: wider blends soften the transition but may spread grain or flicker over a larger area. Narrower blends make the transition more noticeable.
voxy.config.general.lodBoundaryInset.too:
Moves the outer blend edge toward the player by this many blocks, placing the transition where normal terrain is more likely to be loaded and reducing edge gaps. Requires smooth terrain blending.
Tradeoff: larger values bring simplified distant terrain closer; smaller values may expose seams near unloaded terrain.
voxy.config.general.environmental_fog.to: Enables or disables voxy rendering environmental fog
voxy.config.general.ssao_mode.tooltip: The mode used for screenspace ambient occlusion (Auto attempts to pick the best option while reducing performance impact)
voxy.config.general.fogIntensity.tooltip: Intensity of the fog, higher values make the fog thicker and reduce visibility
voxy.config.general.fogDensity.tooltip: Shapes the fog falloff curve - higher values make the transition more extreme (clear up close, ramping up sharply near the fog distance). 0 is a uniform linear fade
voxy.config.general.skyFogDistance.toolt: End distance for sky fog, in chunks
voxy.config.general.fog_distance.tooltip: Scales voxy's LOD fog distance (100% = fog reaches full at the render edge). Higher = see further before the distant LOD fades to the sky colour.
voxy.join.disableHint: This join message can be disabled from Neo Voxy in Sodium Video Settings.
voxy.join.upgradeCleanup: [Neo-Voxy] If an update causes problems, delete the Neo-Voxy configuration file and the world's Voxy cache, then try again.
voxy.config.general.leafLodMode.tooltip: Controls distant leaf rendering. Fast uses opaque foliage. Balanced uses stable per-block texture rotations, culls hidden internal faces, and keeps irregular mip-aware cutouts at medium impact. Quality preserves fine cutout detail at higher GPU cost.
voxy.config.general.biomeBlendRadius.too: Smooths LOD water colours across biome borders. Range 0–7; changing it rebuilds the renderer.
voxy.config.general.biomeBlendGrass.tool: Also applies biome colour blending to grass and foliage; this increases mesh rebuild work for affected sections.
